help.title: Help
help.description: Quick answers about Oriole and its integrations.
help.needMoreDesc: Full architecture & deployment docs live in this repo. Start with docs/architecture.md.
help.faq1q: How do I create a booking?
help.faq1a: Open the Bookings menu and click “New booking”. The form covers schedule, client, and AI call options — this feature is live after the bootstrap phase.
help.faq2a: Auth is handled by Neon Auth (managed Better Auth). Sessions are JWTs verified by the backend via remote JWKS — no passwords are stored in this app.
help.faq3a: CALL-E calls clients for booking confirmations/reminders automatically. Incoming webhooks are recorded with idempotency, then queued to Inngest.
help.faq4a: Paddle acts as the Merchant of Record. Subscription status is synced via HMAC-verified webhooks to an Inngest function.
help.faq5q: When will production feature pages ship?
help.faq5a: This app shell is the foundation. Production dashboard, booking, billing, and analytics are being built on the connected plumbing (DB, auth, billing, jobs, email).
